title: Mathman's Pack
description: Quality of life recipes and some new advancements.
body:
# Mathman's Pack

A quality of life datapack that adds several recipes and advancements that try to feel mostly vanilla.

## Recipes

This datapack's recipes include:

- Golem spawn eggs, crafted the same as how they are placed in the world
- The remaining horse armor recipes
- Some items only found in chests, such as saddles and name tags
- A recipe for Reinforced Deepslate
- The recipe for Enchanted Golden Apples

## Advancements

This datapack also includes some (mostly hidden) fun advancements:

- Among Us?!
 - Eating Suspicious Stew
- Well-Timed Block
 - Stun a Ravager using a shield
- Broken Legs
 - Take 5 hearts of fall damage
- First Blood
 - Kill another player -- this one is specifically hidden so that it's not a problem in singleplayer
- Above and Beyond
 - Go above the Nether roof
- Challenging Feat
 - Defeat the Ender Dragon without any armor
- Seriously Rich
 - Obtain a Netherite Block

## Other

This datapack also adds the Netherite Upgrade smithing template to the Piglin bartering loot table.
